method: All 1,104 source/back-translation pairs compared by the source-aware AI reviewer; source facts, periods, day boundaries, free-tier scopes, price/date placeholders and privacy negatives compared. All current target values mechanically checked against snapshots. Target-language uncertainty rows and source usage contexts reviewed, with selected primary references resolving terminology. This is the source-aware stage, not a new blinded translation.
limits: AI linguistic QA only; no native-speaker or human certification.
No legal-policy rewrite, legal sufficiency/compliance conclusion, or test that actual platform subscription rules match the source.
Source strings and actual code context are the equivalence baseline; this review does not certify on-device audio implementation.
No UI rendering, device menu navigation or runtime StoreKit purchase executed.
Recommended corrections are guarded proposals, not applied repository edits.
